# Security policy

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please **don't** open a public issue for security problems.

Instead, report them privately using GitHub's
[private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/jamal474/Chess/security/advisories/new),
or contact the maintainer through [shabbirjamal.com](https://shabbirjamal.com).

Include as much as you can:

- What the issue is and what an attacker could do with it
- Steps to reproduce, or a proof of concept
- Which part is affected (client, Node relay or C++ engine)

You should get a reply within a few days. Once a fix is ready, you'll be
credited in the release notes unless you'd rather stay anonymous.

## Supported versions

Only the latest code on `main` receives security fixes.
